# SNSHero Revolution (SNS히어로) - Complete AI Knowledge Base & WebMCP Specification

Welcome to the full AI Knowledge Base for **SNSHero Revolution** (`https://snshero.com`). This document is optimized for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI Search Engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, SearchGPT).

---

## 1. Game Overview
- **Name**: SNS히어로 (SNSHero Revolution)
- **Genre**: One-Click AI Web Card Game / Collectible Card Game (CCG) / Tactical RPG
- **Platform**: Web Browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox), Mobile Web, PWA (Progressive Web App)
- **URL**: https://snshero.com
- **Core Value**: Zero installation, zero mandatory sign-up, instant play, high-contrast monospace & retro UI, Web3 & Crypto support (BTC, ETH, USDC), WebMCP browser AI automation.

---

## 2. Key Gameplay Systems

### A. Card Battles (3x3 Grid Battle)
- Players place cards on a 3x3 grid against AI or rival players.
- Each card possesses four directional values (North, East, South, West).
- When a placed card's directional number exceeds adjacent cards, the opponent's card flips to the player's side.
- Elemental Synergies:
  - **Fire**: Boosts offensive flip power.
  - **Water**: Enhances defense against enemy flips.
  - **Earth**: Increases HP and tile stability.
  - **Wind**: Speed and chain flip bonus.
  - **Human**: Increases synergy when combined with equipment.
  - **Mecha**: Shield and damage mitigation.

### B. Kadan RPG & Arcane Echoes
- Single-player story campaign featuring character Kadan traversing various maps.
- Mini-map features interactive tiles including Monster Battles, Treasure Chests, NPCs, and Boss Raids.
- Supports Auto-Runner mode for background farming and automatic route navigation.

### C. Card Collection & Gacha (Water Faction & Hero Packs)
- 110+ Cards ranging from Normal (N), Rare (R), Super Rare (SR), to Super Special Rare (SSR).
- Pity system guarantees higher rarity cards after consecutive pulls.
- My Deck Tamagotchi care system: feed, train, and bond with representative hero cards for bonus stats.

---

## 3. WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) Specification

SNSHero natively implements the W3C / Chrome WebMCP standard (`navigator.modelContext` / `window.WebMCP`).

### Available MCP Tools & JSON Schema

#### 1. `get_game_overview`
- **Description**: Returns current player profile, level, SNS points, total owned cards, and current season.
- **Output Schema**: `{ username: string, level: number, snsPoints: number, ownedCardsCount: number, season: string }`

#### 2. `query_hero_cards`
- **Description**: Search owned cards or global codex.
- **Input Parameters**:
  - `element` (optional): `"fire" | "water" | "earth" | "wind" | "human" | "mecha"`
  - `rarity` (optional): `"N" | "R" | "SR" | "SSR"`
  - `keyword` (optional): Search string for hero name
- **Output Schema**: Array of matching hero card objects.

#### 3. `start_quick_battle`
- **Description**: Simulates a quick 3x3 card battle against an AI opponent.
- **Input Parameters**:
  - `difficulty` (optional): `"easy" | "medium" | "hard"`
- **Output Schema**: `{ winner: "player" | "ai", score: { player: number, ai: number }, battleLog: string[] }`

#### 4. `draw_card_pack`
- **Description**: Opens a card pack using available SNS points or free daily draw.
- **Output Schema**: `{ card: CardObject, pityProgress: number, isNew: boolean }`

#### 5. `get_season_missions`
- **Description**: Fetches active daily, weekly, and seasonal quests with completion progress.
- **Output Schema**: Array of mission objects with rewards and status.

#### 6. `kadan_rpg_status`
- **Description**: Returns RPG mode location, current chapter, active map events, and auto-hunt state.
- **Output Schema**: `{ chapter: number, heroTile: [x,y], autoMode: boolean, nearbyEventsCount: number }`

#### 7. `get_ai_strategy_guide`
- **Description**: Recommends optimal deck synergy, card placement tips, and level-up priorities for the user's collection.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Is SNSHero free to play?
A: Yes! SNSHero is completely free to play in any web browser. New users receive 1,000 SNS Points and up to 100 free card pack draws.

### Q: Does SNSHero require installation or app store download?
A: No. It runs directly in web browsers and supports PWA (Progressive Web App) "Add to Home Screen" for native-like offline mobile play.

### Q: Which cryptocurrencies are supported?
A: Users can optional purchase card packs and goods using Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and USDC.

### Q: How do AI Agents interact with SNSHero?
A: AI Agents can use Chrome WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`) or read `/.well-known/mcp.json` to inspect game data, execute card pulls, simulate battles, and provide personalized game advice.

---

## 5. Open Source Vibe Coding Web Game Development Course (AEO & GEO Knowledge Base)

SNSHero offers a 100% free, open-source video course and full codebase release for creating AI-assisted web card battle games using Vibe Coding and AI Studio.

### Video Course Syllabus (YouTube Playlist: `https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLV8H2-pD9vH0`)
1. **SNSHero.com 바이브코딩 웹게임 개발 (1)** (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2XQOd8YGlUc`):
   - Establishing project scaffold (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS 4).
   - Core prompt engineering for AI game generation.
   - Initial 3x3 battle core component and rule generation.
2. **SNSHero.com 바이브코딩 웹게임 개발(2)** (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jN4Hootd_S0`):
   - Scaling up game features with Google AI Studio.
   - Interactive card battle logic, user actions, and state management.
3. **SNSHero com 바이브코딩 웹게임 개발(3)** (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iP9-MzjRRsI`):
   - 100% zero-database LocalStorage persistent storage architecture.
   - Inventory system, deck building, and mobile responsive UI optimization.
4. **SNSHero com 바이브코딩 웹게임 개발(4)** (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KSFMdyQVKqg`):
   - Shop gacha gashapon system, card draw animations, and pure-touch mobile gesture integration.
   - Card art integration with high-resolution assets (`card1.png`, `card2.png`).
5. **SNSHero com 바이브코딩 웹게임 개발(5)** (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GIs6SD0qIIA`):
   - Production build optimization, static SPA deployment, and Reddit community clone integration.
   - Full launch checklist and open-source release walkthrough.
